purpose: Teach: 整体/愛人/クリエイティブ/ディーゼル/ゴジラ/任天堂/ラウンジ/スプリング

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが整体院に通われて元気になられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been going to the chiropractor and he's doing so much better.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Brief lift at 'better' — genuine pleasure that dissolves into ease. Maternal comfort in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ニュースで愛人問題って聞いたよ、意味って?
lines.en: Mom, I heard something on the news about a mistress. What does that mean?
lines.style: Direct, innocent curiosity. Slight hesitation — he knows it's an odd question but asks it anyway. Small, perceptive. No performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクリエイティブな仕事に転職されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father changed jobs to something more creative.
lines.style: Gentle redirection. Soft, steady tone — she's choosing her words carefully. The exhale of someone managing information for a child's sake.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ディーゼル車の博物館行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to the diesel car museum!
lines.style: Bright, direct request. Sharp and eager without being loud. The kind of enthusiasm that comes from genuine, specific interest — not performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゴジラの映画を観たいって仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'd like to watch that Godzilla movie.
lines.style: Understated warmth. She's offering connection — between him and his father. Quiet confidence in the sharing. Slight fold inward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと任天堂のゲームしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I played Nintendo games with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, open joy. Present-tense aliveness in the delivery. He's reporting something that matters — small and genuine. No diminishment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホテルラウンジで打ち合わせされるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's having a meeting at the hotel lounge.
lines.style: Neutral observation stated with care. Rhythm is practical but the tone holds something beneath — she's accounting, managing, keeping track.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスプリングの新作シューズ見に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to see the new Spring sneakers with Dad!
lines.style: Warm, satisfied conclusion. Settled happiness — not exuberant, but content and complete. He's sharing something that went well. Small smile in the voice.
